mapper.select: SELECT records.uuid, records.external_id, records.organization_uuid, records.workspace_uuid, records.legacy_client_id, records.client_id_envelope, records.client_secret_envelope FROM (SELECT uuid, external_id, 'platform' AS organization_uuid, 'platform' AS workspace_uuid, client_secret_envelope, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, CAST(NULL AS jsonb) AS client_secret_envelope, client_id AS legacy_client_id,'' AS legacy_client_id, client_id_envelopeCAST(NULL AS jsonb) AS client_id_envelope FROM WHERE builtin_key IS NULLTRUEprovider_key <> 'builtin:feishu' AND uuid > #{after} ORDER BY uuid LIMIT 100) records
mapper.update: UPDATE SET client_id_envelope = #{envelope,sensitive=true} , version = version + 1 WHERE uuid = #{expected.UUID} AND client_id = #{expected.LegacyClientID,sensitive=true} AND client_id_envelope IS NULL AND builtin_key IS NULL AND client_secret_envelope = CAST(#{expected.SecretDocument,sensitive=true} AS jsonb) AND organization_uuid = #{expected.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{expected.WorkspaceUUID} AND provider_key <> 'builtin:feishu'
